acceptance.requirement: An introducing commit is complete only when its parent was inspected and the finding was absent there (the evidence is named); a parent whose replay failed yields partial with the reason.

The origin corpus holds adverse histories (a revert of a fix with revertOf named, a cherry-pick with -x with cherryPickOf named, a squash merge, an amended introducing commit, a git mv after introduction, a dirty file with a committed vulnerable line, a merge whose first parent carries the flaw, a conflict resolution that writes the flaw, a transitive lockfile bump with the chain re-derived, an unreachable forge provider recorded as a limitation) beside the existing cases, 23 of 23 resolved, gated in the pre-push gate. The provenance record, its terminal states, confidence reasons, eligibility definition, identity rules, default behaviour and shared timeout are frozen in a contract page held by a contract test that check-ga-contracts runs. The overhead bench holds the wall time provenance adds to a frozen absolute budget (cold 2000 ms, warm 250 ms at p95 on the 15-finding fixture) beside its ratio gates; the 1.3x ratio target is withdrawn with the reason recorded.
